# Boise Remodeling Co - Full Reference

> Design-build remodeling for kitchens, bathrooms, whole-home renovations, room additions, and ADUs in Boise, Idaho and the Treasure Valley. One accountable team handles design, estimating, permits, and construction under a single contract.

## About

Boise Remodeling Co is a residential design-build remodeling company serving the Treasure Valley since 2017. Design-build means design, permitting, and construction are delivered by one team under one contract, which removes the handoffs between a separate designer and general contractor and keeps each project on a single coordinated schedule. Every project includes a written scope before construction, clear allowances for selections, proactive communication throughout the build, and a workmanship guarantee at completion.

- Business type: Design-build remodeling contractor (residential)
- Founded: 2017
- Service model: Single accountable team for design, permits, and construction
- Contact: https://boiseremodeling.co/contact
- Project estimator: https://boiseremodeling.co/#calculator

## Service area

We serve the following Treasure Valley cities across Ada and Canyon County:

- Ada County: Boise, Meridian, Eagle, Kuna, Star
- Canyon County: Nampa, Caldwell, Middleton

Permit paths differ between Ada County and Canyon County; we coordinate submissions, fees, and inspections as part of the design-build contract.

## Common questions

- How long does a remodel take? Most projects run several weeks of design and permitting followed by weeks to months of construction, depending on scope and whether layout or structural changes trigger plan review.
- Do I need permits? Cosmetic updates often do not, but layout, structural, plumbing, or electrical changes require permits through Ada or Canyon County.
- How do I keep a remodel on budget? Define scope in writing, lock selections before construction, hold a 10-15% contingency for concealed conditions in older homes, and compare bids only when allowances and permits match.
